# RAZZO

> RAZZO is a business studio founded by Jaqueline Razo that builds practical systems for growing businesses through three ventures: VARKORA (industry systems and operational software), ORNIVA (digital growth: websites and CRM) and CYRANTA (data intelligence: research and data).

Jaqueline Razo is a software engineer by training with 9+ years across data, product and business transformation, working with teams in Mexico, the U.S., Europe and Türkiye. She also speaks and runs corporate training on technology, AI and building businesses. RAZZO works with teams worldwide.

## Ventures

- VARKORA (Industry Systems): custom back-office systems and connected workflows for contractors, real estate and operations-heavy teams that have outgrown spreadsheets and disconnected tools (lead to estimate, job and payment). Contact: https://razzobusiness.com/contact.html?intent=systems
- ORNIVA (Digital Growth): websites, lead capture, CRM and follow-up that work as one system, so inquiries turn into booked work. Contact: https://razzobusiness.com/contact.html?intent=growth
- CYRANTA (Data Intelligence): research, structured data and market intelligence for market and operational decisions. Contact: https://razzobusiness.com/contact.html?intent=data
